change_vs_ref: + --aug_tel_p 0.25 --aug_tel_codecs g723_1 amr_nb (telephony codecs on 25% of the codec calls)
rationale: the telephony augmentation from origin/feature/model-updates, restricted to the unreserved codecs
hypothesis: B4a never sees narrowband CELP / ADPCM telephony audio, so it reads codec smoothing and the 4 kHz band edge on bona fide speech as synthesis. Training both classes through G.723.1 / AMR-NB on 25% of the codec calls makes those traces class-neutral, and that transfers to the unseen G.722 / G.726 / GSM implementations in sim_heldout_v1.
predicted_signature: vs B4a, same readout: sim_heldout_v1 recall_bona up, driving heldout F1 up; sim_matched_v1 F1 down by at most 0.5 (Opus apps, now 25% fewer Opus clips); dev_online_clean F1 within 0.5; spoof recall within 0.5 on every set; probe sets steady. Caveat: sim_heldout_v1 also has the bandlimit / resample8k stages, so part of a heldout gain can be narrowband familiarity rather than codec transfer; Codabench decides.
falsifier: heldout F1 delta < +0.5 on both readouts while matched F1 drops > 0.5 -> drop the lever.
eval_note: pre-registered: top-5 merge half_B WF1 vs B4a merge, paired bootstrap 2000; positive = delta > +0.5 with CI low > 0 and clean F1 drop <= 0.5; within +-0.5 null; below -0.5 negative.
